name: 14032-embedprefill-qwen3emb06b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B. Apache 2.0, ungated, ~1.2 GB, one safetensors file.
parallelism: tp1 on one GPU. No pipeline, data or expert parallelism, and no external cache tier.
architecture: A Qwen3ForCausalLM checkpoint served as an embedding model; 0.6B dense, tied embeddings. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate 46 requests/s, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 600 s safety cap. The offered rate is deliberately above what the server is expected to clear.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix and no shared structure: exactly 6000 prompt tokens per request, drawn independently, sent to /v1/embeddings. The response is one vector and there are no output tokens.
purpose: A semantic search service embedding 6000-token documents into single vectors on one GPU at 46 requests per second.
launch:
# Required, and not merely a route selector: the checkpoint's architecture string is a causal LM,
# so without `is-embedding` the engine serves it as one instead of exposing /v1/embeddings.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
is-embedding: true

tp-size: 1

# A deliberate downcast -- the checkpoint declares bfloat16.
dtype: float16

disable-radix-cache: true

# -1 turns chunked prefill off, so a batch is whole requests rather than a sliced token budget.
chunked-prefill-size: -1
max-prefill-tokens: 32768
